value="RELATIONSHIP KEY
Each child references exactly one parent.
Each parent may have zero or many children.
All domain foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE.

COLUMN KEY
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key
NN = NOT NULL; unmarked columns allow NULL
GEN = generated column; IDENTITY columns are NN." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="270" width="570" x="40" y="1010" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="erd-notes" parent="1" style="rounded=0;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fillColor=#F3F6F4;strokeColor=#B1C7BF;strokeWidth=1.6;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=15;fontColor=#203A36;fontStyle=0;spacing=12;align=left;" value="SCHEMA NOTES
Composite activity FK prevents a zone from another project being referenced. GiST index supports zone geometry; other indexes support project/date and measurement history reads. Area and layer volume are query results, not stored columns.

The migration runner also creates schema_migrations(name PK, applied_at). It is an operational ledger, outside the four domain tables. No users, sensors, soil batches, rule versions or attachment tables exist in this schema." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="1120" x="680" y="1175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
RELATIONSHIP KEY
Each child references exactly one parent.
Each parent may have zero or many children.
All domain foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE.
COLUMN KEY
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key
NN = NOT NULL; unmarked columns allow NULL
GEN = generated column; IDENTITY columns are NN.

div.div:
SCHEMA NOTES
Composite activity FK prevents a zone from another project being referenced. GiST index supports zone geometry; other indexes support project/date and measurement history reads. Area and layer volume are query results, not stored columns.
The migration runner also creates schema_migrations(name PK, applied_at). It is an operational ledger, outside the four domain tables. No users, sensors, soil batches, rule versions or attachment tables exist in this schema.
